findings.title: unifiedDiff emits undefined lines for prefix append
scanner-secondary estimate vs execution model mismatch
secondary and patcher calls aggregated as verifier
unifiedDiff emits line 0 header when one side is a prefix
findings.claim: unifiedDiff does not handle the prefix case: when one file is a prefix of the other findIndex returns -1 with different lengths, the guard only returns for equal lengths, so the hunk header is built with start+1 == 0 producing an invalid @@ -0 ... @@ header.

findings.title: secondary scanner calls aggregated as verifier
findings.claim: usage aggregation maps only exact role scanner to scanner-correctness, so scanner-secondary calls fall through to verifier and secondary scan cost/tokens are misattributed to the verifier role.

findings.title: repro.enabled omits mockPipeline while execution uses it
findings.claim: L3 is executed when config.mockPipeline is true, but run.json repro.enabled ignores mockPipeline, so mock-pipeline runs execute repro while reporting repro disabled and hiding the reproduced count.

findings.title: hard-budget model fallback differs from actual secondary scanner
findings.claim: hard-budget estimate for scanner-secondary falls back to scannerModel while the actual secondary agent falls back to verifierModel, so the preflight prices the wrong model when secondaryScannerModel is unset.
